name: Polyphemus (Eye.Art)
description: Generates and edits images, icons, and editable SVG from natural language or page code (HTML/CSS/JSX/TSX) via a no-key MCP server and REST API; async raster jobs return a pollable job id.

skills.name: Generate Images
skills.description: Creates raster images from a natural-language prompt; long jobs return a job id to poll (eye_art_make_image).

skills.name: Generate Editable SVG
skills.description: Returns real editable SVG source for a described graphic or icon, verified to emit image/svg+xml markup (eye_art_make_svg).

skills.name: Edit Existing Images
skills.description: Applies prompt-driven edits to an image already produced or supplied in the session (eye_art_edit_image).

skills.name: Suggest Prompt Ideas
skills.description: Returns generated prompt suggestions with title, prompt text and corpus mix for image or SVG requests (eye_art_prompt_ideas).

skills.name: Poll Job Status
skills.description: Checks the state of an asynchronous image job by its id until the result is complete (eye_art_image_status).

skills.name: Manage Conversations
skills.description: Creates sessions and lists, fetches, displays or deletes prior image conversations and their creations.
